title: Human Dignity
definition: Human Dignity refers to humanity’s God-given worth and purpose.
summary: Human Dignity refers to humanity’s God-given worth and purpose.
christFocus: Christ is the perfect image of God and restores broken image-bearers into renewed likeness.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Human Dignity teaches that every person bears dignity from God rather than from usefulness, health, productivity, or approval. Scripture tells the truth about humanity without denying dignity and without minimizing the ruin sin has brought.

God gives this truth so people may stop hiding and come into the light. People who feel unwanted, disabled, overlooked, or rejected need to know their worth is not granted by society. The Bible’s honesty is mercy because what remains hidden cannot be healed rightly.

Christ enters the truth this doctrine exposes. Christ is the perfect image of God and restores broken image-bearers into renewed likeness. In Him, sinners are not left under guilt, shame, bondage, fear, or death; they are called to repentance, faith, restoration, and new life by the power of the Holy Spirit.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
People need this truth because sin, shame, weakness, and brokenness are not solved by denial. People who feel unwanted, disabled, overlooked, or rejected need to know their worth is not granted by society. Scripture tells the truth so that people may stop hiding and come to Christ.

It also protects believers from shallow answers. Humanity needs forgiveness, new birth, restoration, and Spirit-empowered obedience, not merely better circumstances or stronger willpower.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Honor God’s image in yourself and others with humility and love. Bring this doctrine into prayer, Scripture, and daily obedience. Ask the Holy Spirit to make the truth real in your thinking, desires, relationships, and next faithful step with Christ.
